source_commit_message: feat(120): add openalex_client.py — free academic search, DOI verification, retraction check, abstract restoration
provenance_chain: a797b07 (106) → f423361 (120 baseline) → 5d33b72 (openalex_client.py added in 120) → 9361c1e (121 work on top)

code_audit.abstract_restoration_logic: Reconstructs word array from inverted index positions, joins with spaces
code_audit.is_retracted_handling: Correct — reads is_retracted from OpenAlex response, does not treat as complete retraction database
code_audit.oa_url_note: oa_url is returned as metadata field; tool docstring states '本工具返回元数据和摘要，不返回全文'
code_audit.failure_handling: HTTPError 404 returns None; other errors propagate; timeout=30s on all requests
code_audit.rate_limit_handling: Uses polite pool via mailto parameter; DEFAULT_MAILTO='research@ignition.local'
code_audit.notes: Code is clean, well-documented, uses only stdlib (urllib, json, sys). No external dependencies.

migration_note: openalex_client.py was added in commit 5d33b72 which is part of the 121 branch history (121 was built on top of 120 which included this file). No separate cherry-pick needed.
